text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0564, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to award a firm fixed price contract, Contract No. DR135489 for six swing loaders with hi-rail gears to SWNG Inc. (DBA Swingmaster), the lowest responsive and responsible bidder, for a total contract amount of $2,573,400, plus applicable California’s use tax, subject to the resolution of any properly submitted protest(s), if any.
summary: Awarding a contract to SWNG Inc. (dba Swingmaster) for six swing loaders with hi-rail gears for a total contract amount of $2,573,400 plus applicable California use tax.
